w: During the evening assembly the Minister of Agriculture, Zambia, Shri Suresh Desai, and the Indian Ambassador H.E. Shri Atri were honored. In his address, Shri Suresh Desai praised the noble work of Swamishri and the tranquility and beauty of Akshardham monument.

After the morning puja Swamishri celebrated the Makar Sankranti Joli Utsav. Swamishri explained the significance of the festival as a day on which householders, to earn merits, reverently offer charity to the sadhus and sanyasis. Swamishri then spoke out the call for charity uttered by sadhus, - 'Narayan Hare Sacchidanand Prabho' The kishores clapped in appreciation of Swamishri's crisp, sweet voice. At 10.30 a.m. Swamishri depated from Perry and lauded at Charlotte at 11.30 a.m.

In the evening assembly at Charlotte, Swamishri was welcomed by the Mayor of Matthews town, Mr.Lee Myers. He presented the 'Key to the City' to Swamishri and requested him to visit the city again and again.

Life's Purpose At 8:25 p.m., after the evening assembly a youth asked Swamishri, "What is the purpose of life?" Swamishri replied, "Oh! There are so many things to do in life. Since you are studying now you should study properly and secondly do satsang. The former is for the happiness of one's physical self and the latter for the redemption of one's atma. No matter how much you earn you should remain firm in 'agna' and 'upasana'. In terms of 'niyam' (moral instruction) you should principally be a vegetarian, have no drinks, no cigarettes and no meat; and keep good company and love your parents."

Tolerance During the afternoon, Swamishri's room had turned very cold. When this was brought up Swamishri replied, "Yes, my pillow, bed and the quilt had become very cold. The quilt did not stay close to the body. I simply lay awake in such a condition for an hour." "Then you should have woken me up," the attendant sadhu said. "But I thought why should I wake you up? Because then it would have spoilt your sleep also. And besides, I felt that since I have tolerated for this long then let's tolerate it for a little more time…" Without a word of complain, Swamishri bore the cold for over an hour.

H.E. President of India, Dr Abdul Kalam, arrived at the Swaminarayan Mandir in Shahibaug at 9.15 a.m. He was welcomed with a garland at the mandir gate by Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami. Then, children welcomed him with flowers as he walked on a red carpet.

As Dr Kalam arrived before Swamishri the sadhus sang Vedic peace mantras. Swamishri welcomed him with a garland. Accompanying the president were secretary Shri Y.S. Rajan, Chief Minister Shri Narendrabhai Modi and other officials.
The dialogue that followed between Swamishri and President Kalam is as follows:
Swamishri : It is a matter of great joy that you have come here in this sacred mandir in the holy month of Shravan.

Dr Kalam : I came, because after I became the President, I thought I must come and seek your guidance. Well, the important thing in our country is how do we bring the unity of minds. The unity of minds shall shape, shall be the foundation for growth of our Nation. Swamishri, spiritual institutions like Swaminarayan can have a tremendous influence in bringing together the people. I have one thought in my mind. The land of Gujarat has given the best of minds. Mahatma Gandhi who lived here gave us peace. Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel who lived here united the country. Vikram Sarabhai who gave us technology and made the space programme... And we have a great spiritual institution like the Swaminarayan and many such institutions… whose integrated efforts will give permanent peace to the state and our country.

Swamishri : There is an abundant need for harmony and unity. The feelings of Gandhi, Sardar and religious organizations lie at the root of our Indian culture. The sentiments of Indian culture say that we are all God's children, therefore, we should stay together and strive for the progress of our country. The change we see today is due to decreasing of spiritualism in people's lives. There is a lessening of faith. And these cause differences in mind and the subsequent rise in problems. But our feelings are that if everyone works with unity, then our country will progress properly. If there are feelings of hatred and vengeance among people then of what use will it be? If you think spiritually that God resides in everyone and if you see God in everyone then whom will you hate! With whom will you fight! Whose things will you take away! We are all one. Together we can help our country progress. My guru, Yogiji Maharaj, used to give an example about unity. A king once called his official and told him to break the quiver full of arrows. But he couldn't and neither could anyone. Then on taking a single arrow he told a weak soldier to break it and he did. Likewise, if we are united then no one can break us. There is an abundant need for such unity in our country."
Dr Kalam : We all should work together. We will work together.

Swamishri : God has blessed you with the highest position in India. You are appropriate for this and thus God will work through you. You have faith in God. You have studied the Gita and Bhagwat. You have noble feelings for the progress of India, for inspiring unity in all and that there be no conflict among people. God will inspire others through you. I too shall pray to God that through you may all derive inspiration to give up hatred. By hating one cannot stop hatred. Only by giving up hatred can hatred be dissolved. This will be accomplished because there are other officials like you who are thinking in the same manner. I will pray to God to inspire such feelings in all people.
Dr Kalam : I want all your blessings. I will try to see how I can be useful to our country.

After the dialogue, Swamishri introduced the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj, saying, "This murti is 200 years old. Bhagwan Swaminarayan and my Guru used to keep Him with them. He worshipped Him every day. Only after offering water to Him would he drink water. If anyone brought a garland it would be offered to Him first and then he would accept it. He believed that everything belonged to God so whatever we take should be first offered to Him."
Dr Kalam folded his hands before Harikrishna Maharaj and bowed his head in respect before the murti.
Swamishri then gave prasad to the President and other officials.

As he took leave through the mandir precinct, the joy of the devotees who said the 'Jai' of Swamiji in a loud chorus touched him. He said, "A true spiritual leader can inspire spontaneous joy. Pramukh Swami has the purity and energy to reach every heart. I feel satisfied that I came."
President Abdul Kalam spent twenty-two minutes during his visit and felt happy and blessed.

st.t: H.E. Abdul Kalam, President of India, meets Pramukh Swami Maharaj at BAPS Mandir, Amdavad, 13 August 2002
w: News of BAPS - H.E. Abdul Kalam, President of India, meets Pramukh Swami Maharaj at BAPS Mandir, Amdavad, 13 August 2002

The President and Pramukh Swami Maharaj engaged in dialogue Download high resolution file (827 kb) Pramukh Swami Maharaj introduces the murti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj to the President Download high resolution file (861 kb) (From left to right) Pujya Doctor Swami, Chief Minister of Gujarat Shri Narendra Modi, HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj, President of India Dr. Abdul Kalam, Secretary Dr. Y.S. During his visit to Gujarat, the President of India Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam visited Pramukh Swami Maharaj at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir on Shahibaug road, Amdavad.

The President delayed his visit to Bhuj to make time for this meeting with Pramukh Swami Maharaj. The President was welcomed and garlanded at the main gate by Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami. A red carpet was carried out for the President and his route was lined by young children showering flowers to welcome him. Hundreds of devotees lined his route to greet him with applause and cheers. Despite the large number of people, the President was pleased by their discipline and the efficient crowd management by the BAPS volunteers.

As the President entered the meeting hall, sadhus chanted the 'Shanti Path'. Pramukh Swami Maharaj warmly welcomed the President by Garlanding him. The Chief Minister of Gujarat Shri Narendrabhai Modi, Shri Vadibhai Patel, Secretary Shri Y.S. Rajan, Secretary Shri Sheridan and other dignitaries accompanying the President were also garlanded. Pramukh Swami Maharaj said to the President, "It is a great pleasure for us that you have come to such a pious place as the Mandir, especially during this holy month of Shravan."
Replying, the President said, "After becoming President I had it in my mind to meet you and seek your guidance. Today I have this opportunity."

Then the President asked, "Unity of thought is important for our country. How can this unity be attained? This unity is the foundation for the country's progress. Swamiji, spiritual organizations like your Swaminarayan Sanstha have a great effect on the people and they can bring about this unity. I had a thought in my mind that this great region of Gujarat, on which great peace icons such as Mahatma Gandhi, who talked of peace, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who unified the kingdoms of India, Vikram Sarabhai, who made such great scientific and technological discoveries, and spiritual organizations like your Swaminarayan Sanstha can come together and create unity throughout the country."

Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj replied, "What you say is very valid. There is a great need for unity and cooperation. What you have said about Gandhiji, Sardar and spiritual organizations is at the heart of our Indian Culture. Our Indian tradition teaches us that we are all the children of God and we should live together and work for the progress of the country.

"In the current situation, spirituality and belief in God in people's lives is decreasing and as a result differences are surfacing, thus resulting in many problems. But, we believe that if we remain united, the country can truly progress. Such feelings are indeed great. If there is enmity between the people, of what benefit is it? On a spiritual level, God resides in everyone. And if we see God in every one then towards whom do we direct our enmity? With whom will we fight? Our Guru, Yogiji Maharaj, used to give this same message that we should live with unity and cooperation. Our work is done only through unity. He often told the story of a king who once called his soldiers and told them, 'Break this bundle of arrows.' Nobody was able to do so. Then the king took one arrow and gave it to the weakest person, who was able to effortlessly break the arrow. Similarly, if we have unity nobody can break us. We need such unity and cooperation throughout the country."

After some general discussions, Swamishri blessed the President, "God has placed you on this high position in India. You merit this honour. May God do great deeds through you. You have faith in God and study the Gita and Bhagvat. You have noble intentions for the progress of India and desire that there is unity everywhere and no disputes remain. This is a great traditional Indian sentiment. Through you God will inspire all. We will also pray that through you all differences are resolved. Other leaders of this country also share your feelings, so this task will definitely be achieved. And we will pray to God that all are inspired from within."
As the President was departing Swamishri said, "It is good that you have come to Gujarat. May the difficulties be resolved by you, may there be peace everywhere and may all be inspired."

Returning to his car, the President's route was lined by a large number of devotees. Seeing them, the President said, "A true spiritual leader can inspire spontaneous joy. Pramukh Swami has the purity and energy to reach every heart."

Bal Din "Suvarna Mahotsav" Todays programmes celebrated the 50th anniversary of the BAPS Children's Forum established by Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj in 1954. During the morning session, Doctor Swami spoke on family values and the importance of practicing satsang.

The evening assembly centered around a drama about an old man who remembered his childhood days when he used to attend bal sabha during Yogiji Maharaj's time. In his blessings Swamishri described how Yogiji Maharaj used to inspire children to attend satsang regularly. He then explained the importance of the Akshar Purushottam philosophy by narrating how Yogiji Maharaj used to instruct balaks to recite 'Swami ane Narayan, Akshar ane Purushottam...' He also instructed the balaks to stay away from kusang, such as, eating meat, and to keep good company.

A rickshaw driver named Rohitbhai Upadhyay had come especially from Ahmedabad for darshan. Earning his living by driving a rickshaw for years, he has so far freed many people from addictions while driving his rickshaw, and he has voluntarily donated blood 99 times. Before donating blood for the 100th time, he had come especially to receive Pramukh Swami Maharaj's blessings. Seeing his zeal, Swamishri was pleased. If every satsangi took up a mission like this, where would not only the BAPS organisation but the whole Swaminarayan Sampradaya reach!

When talk turned to the care Pramukh Swami Maharaj has taken of even the humblest person, Amityash Swami said, "Keshav Bhagat could not hear with his ears. How much you spent so that he could hear properly! Hearing this, the devotees and sadhus have been filled with wonder. How compassionate Swamishri is! Otherwise, would anyone spend so much?"

Hearing this, Sarvamangal Swami said, "When I too had cancer, for two years you had me take so many expensive injections every day! Now I am not on any medicine. It is purely your miracle! No one but you could do this."

Swamishri was drinking a herbal decoction and swallowing a pill. While swallowing, Swamishri said naturally, "The sadhus belong to Thakorji, and one must spend for those who serve Thakorji, mustn't one! Whatever can be done for the sadhus must be done, mustn't it!"

Amityash Swami said, "There is a sadhu of the old mandir who also says, 'I read the book about Pramukh Swami, Jena Gune Rijhya Girdhari (He whose virtues pleased the Lord). After reading it, I feel as though I have come out after taking a dip in the Ganga.'"

st.t: British Secretary of State for International Development The Rt Hon Priti Patel MP Visits Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: British Secretary of State for International Development, The Rt Hon Priti Patel MP visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi to experience India’s ageless beauty, borderless culture and timeless values.

Priti Patel was welcomed in a traditional Indian manner with a garland of flowers, a chandlo (vermillion powder) and the tying of the sacred kalva (sacred thread) by trustees and senior volunteers on behalf of Swaminarayan Akshardham and BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha.
After admiring the Mayur Dwar (Peacock Gate), the delegation made their way to the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir where they witnessed the world’s ‘Largest Comprehensive Hindu Temple’.

After offering respects and viewing the Mandir’s architecture, she visited the Gajendra Pithika (Elephant Plinth) that includes 148 life-sized carved stone elephants depicting message of social harmony, peace and spirituality.

Priti Patel offered prayers for world peace and harmony by offering ‘abhishek’, the ceremonial pouring of sanctified water from 151 holy rivers, lakes and ponds across India on the sacred image of Sri Neelkanth Varni.

Thereafter the British Minister experienced the educational exhibition, Sanskruti Vihar – a cultural voyage that sails through 10,000 years of India’s glorious heritage, highlighting India’s contributions to humanity through the ages.

Sharing her experience of Akshardham, British Minister Priti Patel wrote, “A faithful visit and a most humbling experience. A very special Mandir filled with devotion and commitment for all volunteers.”
After breakfast was over, Mahant Swami Maharaj himself recalled people who are called great in the outside world and said:

"In their final days they felt distress and sorrow, and words came out like, 'No one listens to me.' On the other hand, look at the last words of our Gunatit gurus. They have passed it on (they have introduced their successor gurus). A relay race (a race in which one runner hands the baton to another, and the second runner then runs on)."
Then Swamishri said, "Shriji Maharaj passed on." That is, Shriji Maharaj has kept this succession going.

Mahant Swami Maharaj arrived at the Pramukh Swami Maharaj memorial assembly in the huge arena here, the "Smart Financial Centre." At the end, showering blessings, Swamishri said, "First of all, leaving everything else aside, I want to meet everyone, young and old. I am thirsty and hungry to meet everyone, young and old, but it is not possible. It would take years. But Shriji Maharaj has arranged it this way: being close is through understanding. You may be in my lap and yet far away, or far away and yet in my lap. Through understanding we are together. If you follow the commands, we are together, and if you do not, you keep drifting farther and farther away. If you sing the praises of the devotees, you are close."
